sectionIntro: My 18 Roses, Treasures, and Candles—see the full list below.

categories.name: Roses
categories.title: Roses
categories.description:
For my 18 Roses, I have chosen gentlemen who mean a lot to me to join me for this celebration.

When your group is called, we'll share a dance and present a rose to mark this milestone together.

Thank you for being part of my debut story—I can't wait to celebrate with you.

categories.name: Treasures
categories.title: TREASURES
categories.description:
For my 18 Treasures, you are each someone who has played an important role in my growing-up years. I am asking you to gift me something that comes in a set or a pair—something you have chosen with love and meaning.

When your name is called, please present your gift and share a short message about why you picked it for me.

I can't wait to see what you have prepared for my 18th birthday.

categories.name: Candles
categories.title: CANDLES
categories.description:
For my 18 Candles, I have chosen each of you because your friendship has meant the world to me.

When you are called, please light a candle with me and share a favorite memory or a wish for my future.

Thank you for being with me through every chapter—I'm so grateful to celebrate this moment with you.
